div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 新生成视觉/视频资产 或 待升级候选模型 (Candidate Checkpoint)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Tier 1: 18ms 四维确定性 CV 探针高速初筛

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
1. OCR/Logo SSIM >= 0.98?
2. MediaPipe 手部/五官解剖正常?
3. 品牌色 ΔE00 <= 1.2?
4. 视频光流闪烁 <= 阈值?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 毫秒级打回并自动偏移随机种子 (Seed+1) 重新生成 (零 VLM Token 消耗!)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Tier 2: 双盲位置消偏 VLM-as-a-Judge 结构化量表审片 (光影美学 / 运镜连贯 / 指令遵循)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: VLM 综合置信得分落在哪个区间?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 自动签发 C2PA 凭证并放行至全球边缘 CDN ($0.0018/次)

span.p: 路由至人类美术总监复核台并沉淀为新 Few-Shot 校准样本
